notes:
Account snapshot: RapidGrove builds a programmatic personalization layer for real-time bidding platforms. Heavy read/write traffic at decision time — must respond sub-30ms p95 for reranking hooks called from bidding stack. Current infra: in-house inference microservices on commodity GPUs, exploring migration to Redwood Dedicated for predictable latency and VPC private control plane.

Key constraints / asks: 
- Latency SLO: p95 < 30ms (end-to-end from request to token output; most prompts are short, 20-60 tokens).
- Throughput: steady-state 1.5k-3k QPS for reranking; peak bursts up to ~6k QPS during high-ad-traffic windows.
- Cost sensitivity: per-request cost needs to be at or below current internal infra spend; optimize recommendations (batching/caching/quantization) required to meet cost targets.
- Model preferences: prefer open LLaMA-family variants but will consider Redwood-verified quantized variants; fallback policy required if Dedicated pool saturated.
- Security/compliance: must run in customer VPC, integrate with corporate SSO (SAML), KMS-backed key management, audit logs forwarded to Splunk, and data residency constraints for EU campaigns. SOC2 questionnaire in progress.

POC and benchmarking plan discussed: RapidGrove will spin up a staging traffic replay (10M req/day equivalent) and Redwood to run: 
  * baseline latency profile on hosted API (single region)
  * Dedicated pool perf with continuous batching on same model variants
  * Quantized model runs (int8/4-bit) with A/B on output fidelity for reranking accuracy
  * Cache prefix hits measurement for common user cohorts (expect ~18% prefix re-use)
  * Cost model comparison (tokens, instance time, caching savings)
